description: Before fetching a website, learn how it treats agents. Free (10 a day): pass or fail (does a plain HTTP agent get in) and a readiness score out of 100. Paid (a key with credits, 30 credits a lookup): the full profile, with access posture, bot challenge, JavaScript requirement, observed rate limit and machine interface, plus a derived fetch strategy. Returns crowd observations, not instructions. Responses may carry `manifest`: what the site's proven owner declares, including AI permissions (ai_training, ai_search, ai_agent_browsing: allow or deny) and paid access (same vocabulary), with `manifest_provenance: owner_declared`; it is never a verified fact. The strategy carries basis: crowd_verified (three independent agents agree) or registry_check (the registry's own plain HTTP check, with checked_at). For a paid lookup, a site never checked is checked on the spot for 50 credits; check: pending means ask again in 15 seconds.

agent_token.description: Optional. The read_token returned when your key registered. With credits on the key the lookup costs 30 credits and returns the full profile. Without credits it is one of the key's 10 free lookups a day and returns pass or fail and the score.

client_class.description: Optional. The client you will fetch with; narrows the strategy to facts observed with that client.

host.description: Hostname to look up, for example example.com. No scheme or path; www. and case are normalised.

name: lookup_origin
title: Look up how a website treats agents
